data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's definitional gloss 'survived counterexample and remained flagged' smuggles in an unproven survival requirement: a flag that is sustained at adjudication need not have passed through any prior counterexample gauntlet. SRC_001 then baldly asserts the third conjunct — 'failure survived without rebuttal from the original artifact's proponents' — without citing any record of proponents being afforded a rebuttal opportunity or any evidence that no rebuttal was offered. A conjunctive criterion whose final conjunct is unevidenced is not demonstrated to be satisfied.
